text: Android core module: move the data layer into :core with no Android on its classpath (B0)

Merged as 10 cherry-picked commits (10bb060..606a9a0 on the branch; HEAD 89c159d on main), full gate green. Review notes: the JVM-compiled Room class works on the production support path (probed: fresh open, and a version-6 database migrating through MIGRATION_6_7/7_8), but Room generates clearAllTables() only for Android, so AppDb.clearAll() replaces it; ApiSource and DeviceIdProvider interfaces, the device name as a constructor parameter, ItemsRepo.updateField public for the cross-module test. UpdateChecker stays in :app until B1 rewrites it per account. Test count 584 before and after.
